question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Whenever addressed, she comes ____ and performs her ____ in a great way.
solution:
The correct answer is '**forth, role**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**forth**" means forward in time, place, or order. (आगे की ओर)
 
• The word "**role**" means the function assumed or part played by a person in a particular situation. (भूमिका)
 
• Options "**fourth**" and "**roll**" are incorrect in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Whenever addressed, she comes forth__ and performs her __role__ in a great way.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fourth (चौथा)**: means constituting number four in a sequence.
 
• **Roll (लुढ़कना)**: means to move or cause to move in a particular direction by turning over and over.
